say:1:1130149001:1.text: Although Soren and Alsa have hunted many ferocious beasts, they have very little experience fighting against other warriors.
say:1:1130149001:1.source_cn: 索恩和阿尔萨虽然之前猎杀过很多凶猛的野兽，但他们很少有...

say:2:1130149002:1.text: And the Uru Settlement is made up of weak Maulers abandoned by other clans...
say:2:1130149002:1.source_cn: 而且乌尔聚落，都是被其他部落遗弃的弱小蛮血……

say:3:1130149003:1.text: There are so many great warriors outside of the Uru Clan.
say:3:1130149003:1.source_cn: 乌尔之外的部落里，从来都不缺乏强者。
